scope: Every primitive mirror norm, control, D24 root coset, and all seven nonzero spinor residues are exhausted through H=100. Cone geometry is exact through all nonempty packets for p7 and 2*p7, and through the first two packets for the already-known 2 lane. Open H=100 prefixes do not prove global nonreflectivity.

seeds.complete_mirror_norm_proof: For primitive r=(x,y), let I(r)=(a*x,(y,D24+)). Since D24+ is even unimodular, I(r) is a unit away from primes dividing a. Reflection integrality gives (q(r))|2I(r), so no other prime can divide q. At the odd squarefree prime p=(2-theta), either y is primitive and v_p(q)=0, or y lies in pD24+, x is a unit, and q=-a*x^2 mod p^2 has v_p(q)=1. At inert (2), evenness gives y^2 in (2). If a is odd, x a 2-adic unit gives v_2(q)=0, while x in (2) and primitive y gives v_2(q)=1. If a has v_2(a)=1, the whole form is even and the same congruence plus q|2I forces v_2(q)=1. Class number one and U^+=U^2 turn these ideal classes into the displayed totally-positive element representatives. Here v_2(a)=1 and there is no odd support, so every mirror norm ideal is exactly (2); canonical norm 2 is complete.
